answer: The fable escrow is released only against a summit receipt, and the reef audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 51 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 221 aliases means carrying 159 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 11 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
